structured.answer: I'd lean to Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track: it's the only one I saw with 0% shares and 0% foreign currency, with 4.25% a year over 3 years and 0.57% fee, and I know Harel. But I only saw Harel's list, so I'll ask my son or the bank before signing.

stuck.why: Card after card of shares percentages and returns, no sentence saying which track is safe or like a deposit; I lost track and got tired still inside the first company
English letters, 99% shares – felt this page is for gamblers and almost left
Did not know if that means no history, or a bad result

used: Intro text on screen 1 (tax only on profit, no lock, supervised by רשות שוק ההון)
Track card 'כספי (שקלי)': מניות 0%, מט"ח 0%, 4.25% 3 שנים, 3.08% 5 שנים, 0.57% מהחיסכון, 0% מההפקדות
